Package gui

Class VisitorController

java.lang.Object
gui.VisitorController
public class VisitorController extends Object
controller for the visitor / guide home screen (VisitorFrame.fxml).

shows a personalised welcome message, action buttons, and the simulated notification inbox populated by NotificationCenter. on load it also checks for any confirmed bookings tomorrow and adds a reminder notification automatically.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      populates welcome/role labels, wires the notification list cell factory, checks for upcoming-visit reminders, and renders the notification inbox.

    • buildActionTiles

      private void buildActionTiles()
      builds the home-screen action grid: a compact 2-up grid of tiles, each a small colour icon-chip beside a bold title and a short muted description. "Book a Visit" carries a filled pine chip to read as the primary action without changing size.

    • tile

      private javafx.scene.control.Button tile(String title, String desc, javafx.scene.Node icon, String chipClass, javafx.event.EventHandler<javafx.event.ActionEvent> handler)
      builds a compact action tile (chip + title + short description).

    • assembleTile

      private javafx.scene.control.Button assembleTile(javafx.scene.Node icon, String chipClass, javafx.scene.control.Label title, javafx.scene.control.Label desc)
      assembles a chip + (title over description) into a horizontal .action-tile.

    • handleToggleTheme

      public void handleToggleTheme(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      flips the whole app between light and dark mode and updates this button's icon.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • startSessionTimer

      private void startSessionTimer()
      starts a 1-second ticker that keeps the "Session: HH:MM:SS" label current, and stops it automatically if the window is closed.

    • updateSessionTimer

      private void updateSessionTimer()
      writes the current elapsed session time into the header label.

    • startWaitlistPoll

      private void startWaitlistPoll()
      starts a 30-second background poll that checks for waitlist promotions, so a spot that opens up pops the "Good News!" dialog on its own — no manual Refresh or re-login needed. runs on the JavaFX thread (same as the manual refresh) and is guarded against re-entrancy and per-order duplicate popups inside checkWaitlistPromotion().

    • stopSessionTimer

      private void stopSessionTimer()
      stops and releases the session-timer ticker and the waitlist auto-poll if running.

    • updateUpcomingCount

      private void updateUpcomingCount()
      counts the visitor's active upcoming reservations (status PENDING or CONFIRMED with a visit date today or later) and shows a friendly summary on the home card. reuses the order list already fetched by checkUpcomingReminders().

    • handleRefreshNotifications

      public void handleRefreshNotifications(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      refreshes the notification panel from NotificationCenter. re-checks for upcoming-visit reminders before rendering.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • refreshNotifications

      private void refreshNotifications()
      syncs the ListView (and badge count) with the current contents of NotificationCenter. toggles the empty-state label as needed.

    • checkWaitlistPromotion

      private void checkWaitlistPromotion()
      fetches pending waitlist-promotion orders for this visitor. for each one shows a styled "Good News!" popup offering immediate confirmation. also adds an inbox entry and updates the Confirm tile. safe to call multiple times (deduplicates by order ID).

    • showWaitlistPromotionDialog

      private boolean showWaitlistPromotionDialog(logic.OrderDetail o)
      shows a GoNature-themed "Good News!" dialog for a single waitlist-promotion order. "Confirm Now" immediately sends CONFIRM_VISIT and returns true. "Decline" releases the spot to the next visitor in line and returns false. "Later" dismisses without confirming or declining and returns false.

    • declineWaitlistSpot

      private void declineWaitlistSpot(logic.OrderDetail o)
      declines a waitlist-promotion offer at the visitor's request, after a confirmation prompt. sends DECLINE_WAITLIST so the server releases the held order and offers the spot to the next eligible visitor in line, then refreshes the inbox.
      Parameters:
      o - the held promotion order the visitor is declining

    • checkUpcomingReminders

      private void checkUpcomingReminders()
      fetches the visitor's orders and adds a reminder notification for any confirmed/pending booking that falls tomorrow. only adds the reminder once per session (checked by scanning existing entries).

    • handleBookVisit

      public void handleBookVisit(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      opens the booking form as a modal. after it closes the notification panel will show the new booking notification on the next refresh.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • handleViewOrders

      public void handleViewOrders(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      opens My Orders as a modal. after it closes the notification panel will reflect any cancellation notifications that were added.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • handleCancelReservation

      public void handleCancelReservation(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      opens My Orders in cancel-focused mode (from the "Cancel a Reservation" tile): the screen shows only cancellable bookings and prompts the visitor to pick one. distinct from handleViewOrders(ActionEvent), which opens the full read/manage view.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • handleMyDetails

      public void handleMyDetails(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      opens the "My Details" dialog so the logged-in user can view and edit their own personal information (name, email, phone, and — for subscribers — family size and credit card). the ID number is shown read-only.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • handleConfirmVisit

      public void handleConfirmVisit(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      confirms all of the visitor's tomorrow's PENDING/CONFIRMED bookings so the server will not auto-cancel them at the end of the 2-hour reminder window. if there are multiple eligible orders a choice dialog is shown.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • handleRegisterExit

      public void handleRegisterExit(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      lets the visitor register their own park exit without needing an employee. loads the park list, asks the visitor to select which park they are leaving, then sends REGISTER_EXIT using their own session ID.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • showParkExitPicker

      private logic.Park showParkExitPicker(List<logic.Park> parks)
      shows a GoNature-themed park picker for registering an exit. unlike the plain ChoiceDialog it replaces, the content sits on an elevated card (drop shadow + green accent border), uses a styled park selector with location pins, themed buttons, and honours the current light/dark theme.
      Parameters:
      parks - the non-empty list of parks the visitor can choose from
      Returns:
      the selected park, or null if the visitor cancelled
